subject: general
question: __________ was named as the new Shiv Sena president at the party national executive meeting in Mumbai in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eknath Shinde**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Eknath Shinde** is a prominent Indian politician and a senior leader in the Shiv Sena party.
 
• He has held significant positions in Maharashtra's state government, including **Minister of Public Works (Public Undertakings) and Minister of Urban Development and Public Health**.
 
• Shinde is known for his **strong grassroots connect** and his work towards infrastructure development in Maharashtra.
 
• He was named the **new Shiv Sena president** during the party's national executive meeting held in Mumbai in 2023, marking a significant leadership change within the party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiv Sena**

 
 
• Founded in 1966 by Bal Thackeray, Shiv Sena is a right-wing Marathi regional and Hindu nationalist political party in India.
 
• The party primarily operates in Maharashtra and has been a significant force in the state's politics.
 
• It has a strong base among the Marathi-speaking population and has been involved in both state and national politics.
 
• Shiv Sena has been an ally of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) but has also had periods of friction and separation.
 
 
 
• **National Executive Meeting**
 
 
• The national executive meeting is a key event in a political party's calendar where crucial decisions are made regarding leadership, strategy, and future directions.
 
• This meeting typically includes senior leaders and key members of the party.
 
• Decisions taken during these meetings are pivotal for the party's functioning and political strategy.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra Politics**
 
 
• Maharashtra is one of India's most politically significant states, with a complex political landscape involving multiple parties such as the Shiv Sena, BJP, Congress, and NCP.
 
• The state has seen various coalitions and political alliances, often leading to dynamic and changing political scenarios.
 
• Leadership and alliance decisions in Maharashtra have substantial implications for national politics as well.
